title: Custom Chip PCR Preparation
author: Opentrons
materials: nanopure H2O (for additions with P10-multi channel pipette)
Upload your protocol into the OT App.

steps.title: Gather equipment and reagents
steps.instruction: Collect the following items: P10 multi‑channel electronic pipette, 10 µL pipette tips, P50 single‑channel electronic pipette, 300 µL pipette tips, Opentrons 4‑in‑1 tube rack set, Temperature‑200 mL PCR strips (seated), 1.7 mL Eppendorf tubes, custom 3 × 8 offset membrane chip on shaker (mounted on OT‑2 deck), 4 × 6 tube rack for 2 mL Eppendorf tubes (tube A1: nanopure H₂O, B1: MyTaq reaction buffer, C1: primer mix, D1: MyTaq DNA polymerase, A2: empty mastermix tube), and seated PCR strips column 12 containing nanopure H₂O for additions with the P10 multi‑channel pipette.

steps.title: Seat and calibrate chip
steps.instruction: Place the custom 3 × 8 membrane chip on the shaker so that the wells of the second (middle) row are slightly offset toward the top of the first and third rows, then calibrate the chip so that the pipette tip lands just barely above the membrane to avoid disturbing the eggs or crashing into the chip.

steps.title: Download protocol file
steps.instruction: Obtain the protocol file for the OT‑2 robot from the provided source.

steps.title: Upload protocol to OT App
steps.instruction: Upload the downloaded protocol into the OT‑2 application.

steps.title: Arrange deck layout
steps.instruction: Set up the OT‑2 deck according to the deck map, placing the tube rack, PCR strips, chip, and tip racks in the positions indicated in the map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipettes
steps.instruction: Using the OT App, calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the P10 and P50 pipettes; refer to the support article for calibration tips.

steps.title: Start robot run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to begin the automated protocol.

steps.title: Prepare master mix
steps.instruction: In the empty tube (tube A2), combine per‑sample volumes of 15.5 µL nanopure H₂O, 5 µL MyTaq reaction buffer, 10 µL primer mix, and 0.25 µL MyTaq DNA polymerase. Prepare enough for 28 samples (24 samples to be processed plus excess) and mix the contents after the final addition to ensure homogeneity.

steps.title: Transfer chip samples to PCR strips
steps.instruction: Using the calibrated pipette, transfer each sample from the chip to the PCR strips: row 1 of the chip to strip 1, row 2 to strip 2, row 3 to strip 3; as you move across a row to the right, move down the corresponding strip.

steps.title: Add master mix to PCR strips
steps.instruction: Dispense 21.75 µL of the prepared master mix into every well of PCR strips 4, 5, and 6.

steps.title: Add samples and mix
steps.instruction: Transfer 3 µL of each sample from strips 1‑3 to its matching well in strips 4‑6 (e.g., strip 1 well 1 → strip 4 well 1, strip 1 well 2 → strip 4 well 2, etc.) and then mix the destination well by pipetting up and down 10 times.
